Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder_fuzz.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 28, "var": "data", "code": "info.dlpi_addr = reinterpret_cast<ElfW(Addr)>(data);", "note": "Attacker-controlled fuzz input bytes are set as the base address of the PT_NOTE segment."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder_fuzz.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 24, "var": "note.p_filesz", "code": "note.p_filesz = size;", "note": "The PT_NOTE segment length is set to the input size (12 bytes), defining the readable buffer boundary."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder_fuzz.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 25, "var": "note.p_align", "code": "note.p_align = 4;", "note": "Alignment is set to 4, used in the descriptor offset and size calculations."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder_fuzz.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 33, "var": "info", "code": "tcmalloc::tcmalloc_internal::GetBuildId(&info);", "note": "The crafted dl_phdr_info is passed to GetBuildId, which parses the PT_NOTE segment."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 178, "var": "note", "code": "const char* note = reinterpret_cast<char*>(info->dlpi_addr + pt_note->p_vaddr);", "note": "note points to the start of the input buffer (dlpi_addr + p_vaddr = data + 0)."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 179, "var": "last", "code": "const char* const last = note + pt_note->p_filesz;", "note": "last = data + 12 marks the end of the readable buffer."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 184, "var": "nhdr", "code": "const ElfW(Nhdr)* const nhdr = reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Nhdr)*>(note);", "note": "The 12-byte ElfW(Nhdr) header is interpreted from the input: n_namesz=4, n_descsz=0xFFFFFFFB, n_type=3."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 185, "var": "note", "code": "if (note + sizeof(*nhdr) > last) break;", "note": "Bounds check passes: note+12 == last (12-byte input), so the header is considered in-bounds."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 191, "var": "desc_start", "code": "const ElfW(Word) desc_start = (sizeof(*nhdr) + nhdr->n_namesz + align - 1) & -align;", "note": "desc_start = (12 + 4 + 3) & -4 = 16, the aligned offset of the descriptor."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 192, "var": "size", "code": "const ElfW(Word) size = desc_start + ((nhdr->n_descsz + align - 1) & -align);", "note": "size = 16 + ((0xFFFFFFFB + 3) & -4) = 16 + 0xFFFFFFFC = 0x10000000C, which wraps to 12 as uint32_t."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 195, "var": "n_descsz", "code": "if (nhdr->n_descsz >= static_cast<ElfW(Word)>(-align)) break;", "note": "Overflow guard passes: 0xFFFFFFFB < 0xFFFFFFFC, so the wrapped size is not detected."},
  {"step": 12, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 197, "var": "size", "code": "if (size < sizeof(*nhdr) || note + size > last) break;", "note": "Bounds check passes: size=12 is not < 12, and note+12 == last is not > last, so the wrapped size evades detection."},
  {"step": 13, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 200, "var": "n_type", "code": "if (nhdr->n_type == NT_GNU_BUILD_ID) {", "note": "n_type=3 equals NT_GNU_BUILD_ID, so the build-id extraction path is entered."},
  {"step": 14, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 201, "var": "note_name", "code": "const char* const note_name = note + sizeof(*nhdr);", "note": "note_name = note + 12 = last, pointing exactly at the end of the 12-byte input buffer."},
  {"step": 15, "file": "tcmalloc/tcmalloc/internal/profile_builder.cc", "function": "GetBuildId", "line": 202, "var": "note_name", "code": "if (nhdr->n_namesz == 4 && memcmp(note_name, \"GNU\\0\", 4) == 0) {", "note": "n_namesz==4 passes, then memcmp reads 4 bytes starting at note_name=last, which is past the end of the heap buffer: HEAP-BUFFER-OVERFLOW READ 4."}
]
EOF
